title: Nnamdi Madubuike: Return to lineup against Cowboys "in the ballpark"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nnamdi Madubuike: Return to lineup against Cowboys "in the ballpark"
sources.description: Ravens defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike's return from a neck injury progressed to full practice participation this week, but his status for Sunday's game remains unclear.
